c174199938.notes: Blue enamel French-style street plate on a post in Pointe-Noire, shot from below at an angle. Small header gives the city and district (arrondissement 1 E.P. Lumumba, quartier Losange). A cut-off pharmacy cross sign at the left edge is a distractor.

c174199943.reason: near-duplicate of accepted c174199938 (same Boulevard Charles de Gaulle plate from almost the same angle)

c178211195.notes: Blue enamel street plate on a wall in central Pointe-Noire, frontal and sharp; city crest at top left. 'E.P.LUMUMBA' is printed with no space after the last full stop.

c178211194.reason: near-duplicate of accepted c178211195 (same Rue de Limbou plate, slightly cropped)

c169576886.notes: Two crossed green US-style street-name blades on a pole; the lower edge of 'Loufou' is partly hidden behind the mounting bracket and the lower blade. No camera location; category places it in the Republic of the Congo. A shop name ('...MARA') on the building below is a distractor.

c169576885.notes: Green street blades over an octagonal Western Union direction board ('WESTERN UNION ... A 100 mètres'), which is a distractor. The 'Avenue D. C. GANAO' blade is turned away at a steep angle and partly overlapped; slightly soft, upscaled image. Different intersection from c169576886 (shares only the avenue).
